purpose: Teach: キャノン/イージス/トラップ/チルドレン/ブーイング/ミラクル/スリリング/フィニッシュ

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがキャノンのカメラで運動会を撮って下さるわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad is going to film the sports day with his Canon camera.
lines.style: Warm, matter-of-fact. Light lift on the camera detail—sharing something nice she's arranged. Steady, maternal cadence. No fuss, just fact and affection.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとイージス艦のドキュメンタリー観たよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I watched a documentary about Aegis destroyers.
lines.style: Bright and eager, speaking up with something he wants to share. Quick pace, genuine enthusiasm. Slight lean forward in the voice—hoping she'll think it's cool too.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがゲームのトラップの仕掛けを解説して下さるわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad explained how the trap mechanism works in that game.
lines.style: Warm observation, almost to herself. Noticing something tender about him. Soft pace, slight smile in the voice. The tone of someone remembering a moment fondly.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとチルドレンライブラリで本借りたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I borrowed books from the children's library.
lines.style: Eager and open, sharing a small happy thing. Natural, unforced brightness. Quick but not rushed. The voice of a six-year-old who just wants you to know what he did.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「観客のブーイングに動じない」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was saying how important it is not to be rattled by the crowd's boos.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost reflective. She's turning something he said into wisdom. Gentle emphasis on the quiet strength in that idea. Slower, more deliberate than her first line.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとミラクルな逆転試合観たよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I saw an incredible comeback game.
lines.style: Pure childish wonder and excitement. The 'miracle' lands bright. Fast, breathless almost—he can barely hold the excitement in. Open-hearted, no filter.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがスリリングなF1中継を観てらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad is watching a thrilling Formula One race right now.
lines.style: Gentle, present-tense observation. She's noticing what he's doing in the moment. Warm, unhurried. Light touch of amusement that he's so absorbed.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと駅伝のフィニッシュ瞬間を観たよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I watched the finish line of the relay race.
lines.style: Breathless, final. The crescendo of the conversation—he's sharing the most vivid moment. Speed picks up on the finish detail. Genuine awe in the voice, and a sense of closure.
